hook: Ambrozie has led digital transformation at three of the largest consumer-facing organizations in America, Ford, Disney Parks, and now CVS Health, bringing consumer-experience engineering discipline to bear on making AI-driven healthcare personalization work at national scale.
name: Tony Ambrozie

quote.text: Technology in healthcare has to disappear into the experience, the patient shouldn't feel the complexity, they should just feel cared for.
quote.context: A recurring theme in Ambrozie's public remarks on CVS Health's digital strategy

moniker: Healthcare's Digital and AI Transformation Executive

primary.name: Tony Ambrozie, official executive bio, CVS Health Newsroom

timeline.event: Holds senior technology roles at Ford Motor Company
Serves as Chief Digital Officer at Disney Parks, Experiences and Products
timeline.impact: Leads large-scale consumer digital platform strategy

timeline.event: Joins CVS Health as Chief Digital & Technology Officer

quick_facts: SVP and Chief Digital & Technology Officer at CVS Health, leading Health100 initiatives
Previously Chief Digital Officer and Chief Information Officer at Disney Parks, Experiences and Products
Held senior technology leadership roles at Ford Motor Company
Focuses on applying AI to personalize consumer healthcare experiences at scale

achievements.title: Chief Digital Officer, Disney Parks, Experiences and Products
achievements.impact: Led digital platform strategy behind consumer-facing technology across Disney's global theme park and consumer products business.

achievements.title: Senior technology leadership at Ford Motor Company
achievements.impact: Directed enterprise technology strategy at one of the largest global automakers.

achievements.title: SVP, Chief Digital & Technology Officer, CVS Health
achievements.impact: Leads CVS Health's Health100 digital and AI transformation initiative, aimed at applying AI-driven personalization to consumer health services at national scale.
